verdict.rationale: Pylon's Support Agent can be assigned customer issues, deflect questions using content, and take actions, and the issue log lets teams inspect the outcomes the agent produced. The homepage claims agents help with 'resolving' customer work. However, the docs frame the agent's core value as deflection, and nothing shows a resolution metric distinct from deflection or evidence of end-to-end resolution rates. missing for 10: documented end-to-end autonomous resolution, a resolution metric distinguished from deflection or bounces, reported resolution rates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent fully resolves a meaningful share of conversations end-to-end — measured as resolutions, not mere deflections or bounces

citations.quote: Support Agents can deflect customer questions using content, gather internal context for your team, and take action.
Pylon lets humans and agents collaborate on customer work —investigating, resolving, and acting on every signal.
The issue log allows you to inspect all the issues the AI agent is associated with and inspect the outcomes and steps taken by the AI.
